input: Same owner/key/file twice
expected: Same asset ID, one accepted Asset and one eventual Processing job.

input: Same owner/key, different file digest
expected: 409; preserve original Asset.

input: Same asset/owner/source/options, refreshed signed URL
expected: 200 existing job. No duplicate attempt.

input: Valid service token, wrong owner for existing asset
expected: 404. No mutation or information leak.

input: Same asset/owner, changed source revision or operations
expected: 409. Existing job remains unchanged.

input: Repeat retry_request_id after first attempt starts or finishes
expected: 202 current job; no second new attempt.

input: New retry ID while job is queued, processing or done
expected: 409. Wrong owner remains 404.

input: Queued source URL expired before claim
expected: Refresh grant for matching owner/revision; valid source still readable without source credentials.

input: Wrong owner/revision, deleted asset or wrong-direction token
expected: 404 owner/deleted; 409 revision; 401 invalid token. No signed URL.

input: Owner A requests B’s MP4/HLS or attempts path traversal
expected: 404; no key/URL leak.

input: Attempt A finishes after retry attempt B becomes current
expected: No state/output overwrite. Only current attempt can publish.

input: Job commits but enqueue fails, or RQ hash survives lost queue entry
expected: Durable queued work remains discoverable. Step 06 proves repair within target.

input: Upload while Processing is unreachable
expected: 202 after durable intake; queued/pending visible; retry SubmitJob later with same asset ID.

input: Read a submitted Asset while Processing is unreachable
expected: 503, not a synthetic fresh state.

input: Connect/query opposite database using each runtime role
expected: Denied. Correct database DML succeeds; DDL requires own migration role.

input: Delete Asset before a worker finishes
expected: Public 404; new source grants denied; stale output never published; cleanup repeats safely.

input: Create derived Asset, then delete original
expected: Derived immutable source remains available. No new editor UI required.

input: Same workflow via both clients
expected: Response shapes stable; retry sends no file; HLS playlists remain facade-relative.

input: Normal user attempts admin; operator manages another owner’s item
expected: 403 for normal user. Operator checked in MM; Processing still receives a specific owner.

input: Over-limit, wrong MIME/container, duplicate operations or invalid geometry
expected: Admission errors return 413/415/422 before acceptance. Source-dependent geometry/probe failures produce a visible failed attempt after 202; they are not promised synchronous rejections.

input: Reuse a retained upload/edit key for a deleted Asset
expected: 410. Never recreate the deleted Asset implicitly.

input: Mark done without a verified primary output or from deleted job
expected: Transition rejected; no playable success claim.

input: Submit commits but its response is lost; owner deletes the Asset
expected: MM cancels by asset_id. P locks the submission guard, cancels any job and rejects delayed submissions with 410. Test cancel-first and submit-first ordering.

input: Restart MM or interrupt Processing before the derived edit is submitted
expected: Pending Asset stores source descriptor and immutable operations in one transaction. Replayed Submit preserves the original edit fingerprint.

input: Validate requests/responses and examples against contracts
expected: No unresolved references; real handlers must implement the documented cases later.
